title: Open.AI Codex potentially causing System.ArgumentException due to specified path being too short and not having at least one character

comment.body:
Thanks for the PowerToys 0.101.2362 log. It shows PowerToys Run encountering package-location errors while enumerating several installed apps, including the path-too-short `System.ArgumentException`. The current report does not yet show whether this is only a logged and skipped package or whether PowerToys Run is failing for you.

**Needed**
1. Please provide short numbered steps that trigger the entries, including what you do immediately before opening or using PowerToys Run.
2. Please confirm the expected and actual behavior: does PowerToys Run crash or stop responding, or does it continue while one specific app is missing or cannot launch? Please name the affected app if there is one.
3. If the failure is repeatable, reproduce it and submit a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward so the diagnostic state can be correlated with the package error.

This will distinguish a benign Windows package-metadata warning from a reproducible PowerToys Run indexing or launch failure and determine whether a code fix is needed.
